rules: Pick the first task whose status is todo and whose depends_on tasks all pass.
Set status to in_progress and owner to your agent name before starting.
Change only status, owner, passes, and evidence fields.
Set passes to true only after every acceptance item is verified.
Put the verification command output summary in evidence.
Never edit, remove, or weaken acceptance items without human approval.
Set status to blocked and explain in evidence when a dependency or human action is missing.
Use the model and skill named on the task.
Tasks with human set to true need a person at this computer.
Build new UI only under src/features/; never extend the proof-of-concept screens in src/App.tsx.

known_issues: nvidia-smi reports a driver/library version mismatch on 2026-11-07; reboot pending

primary_server.name: Hankflix
primary_server.access: Plain HTTP on the LAN; Kubernetes deployment in the homelab repo
primary_server.discovery: UDP 7359 exposed on the LAN service
primary_server.config: Set FLUSTER_DOGFOOD_SERVER to the server URL; never commit the address or credentials

phases.name: Dogfood foundation
phases.goal: This computer can run Fluster against real Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x servers, and the core invariants are checked by machines.
exit: Tripwire, allowlist, canary, and boundary checks run in CI

tasks.title: Resolve the NVIDIA driver/library mismatch
acceptance: nvidia-smi prints the GPU name and driver version
mpv --hwdec=nvdec plays a local H.264 file with hwdec-current=nvdec

tasks.title: Run pinned Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x dogfood servers
acceptance: tests/integration/docker-compose.yml starts jellyfin 10.11.7 and a pinned 12.x image on separate ports
The 12.x server keeps legacy authorization at its default (off)
Both servers mount tests/samples as a movies and a shows library
A script creates a test user without committing credentials
GET /System/Info/Public succeeds on both
tasks.verify: docker compose -f tests/integration/docker-compose.yml up -d && curl -fsS localhost:8096/System/Info/Public && curl -fsS localhost:8097/System/Info/Public

tasks.title: Assemble the licensed sample media set
acceptance: tests/samples/README.md lists each sample, its license, and its source
Samples cover H.264, HEVC Main10 HDR10, AV1, ASS, PGS, multiple audio tracks, an external .srt sidecar, and a BluRay folder layout
Samples are gitignored or fetched by a script; no media is committed

tasks.title: Automate the server transcode tripwire
acceptance: A script plays each sample through the gateway against both servers
It fails if any active encoding job appears during playback
It fails if any media request lacks Static=true
It writes a short summary to stdout and full logs to a file
CI runs it against the docker fixture

tasks.title: Add the Tauri command allowlist test
acceptance: A Rust test fails when the registered command list differs from an allowlist
The failure message tells the agent to update docs/security.md and record a decision

tasks.title: Add redaction canary tests
acceptance: TypeScript and Rust tests inject a canary token into URLs and errors
Tests fail if the canary appears in any log, error string, or diagnostic snapshot
tasks.verify: pnpm test -- redact && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml redaction

tasks.title: Enforce domain dependency rules with a lint
acceptance: A lint fails when src/domain imports React, the SDK, Tauri, or HTTP code
A lint fails when views import the gateway or player engines outside the composition root
Each lint message names the rule in DOMAINS.md and how to fix it
pnpm check runs the lint

tasks.title: Tighten Rust lints and run release-mode tests
acceptance: Clippy denies debug_assert_with_mut_call, undocumented_unsafe_blocks, and unwrap_used outside tests
CI runs cargo test --release
All existing code passes
tasks.verify: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

tasks.title: Validate tasks/prd.json in CI
acceptance: A test fails on duplicate task ids, unknown depends_on ids, invalid status values, or passes=true without evidence
pnpm check runs it

tasks.title: Add a dogfood launcher
acceptance: pnpm dogfood starts pnpm tauri dev with native trace logging to a redacted file under release-evidence/
The log path is printed on start

tasks.title: Decide the private-LAN HTTP policy
acceptance: A decision record defines when plain HTTP is allowed (for example RFC 1918 and link-local hosts after explicit confirmation)
Tokens are never sent over plain HTTP to public addresses
docs/security.md and ARCHITECTURE.md reflect the decision

phases.name: Jellyfin API correctness
phases.goal: Fluster plays correctly on Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x defaults, and the server provably never transcodes. Plan: docs/plans/active/001-jellyfin-api-correctness.md.
exit: A real title plays on Hankflix

tasks.title: Record PlaybackInfo contract fixtures for 10.11 and 12.x
acceptance: Fixtures cover with and without DeviceProfile, external subtitle, multi-version, and BluRay folder cases
Fixtures are scrubbed per the jellyfin-api contract-fixtures reference

tasks.title: Accept Jellyfin 10.11 and 12.x by semver
acceptance: connect() accepts versions >= 10.11.0 including 12.x
Tests cover 10.10.7, 10.11.7, 12.4.0, and malformed versions

tasks.title: Send the DeviceProfile and enforce source acceptance
acceptance: Every PlaybackInfo request carries FLUSTER_PROFILE
BluRay, Dvd, and Iso VideoType sources are refused
No-source results return a typed refusal reason
The empty-codec-matches-anything assumption is proven by a fixture or the profile is adjusted
Tests assert body and query

tasks.title: Authenticate media requests with headers
acceptance: LaunchRequest carries a typed auth header value
Rust sets http-header-fields for the stream and external subtitles
No request URL contains api_key, ApiKey, or Token
ApiKey is stripped from DeliveryUrl before use
Playback works on the 12.x server with legacy authorization off
tasks.verify: pnpm check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings

tasks.title: Fix Jellyfin to mpv track mapping
acceptance: Embedded tracks map as ff-index + count(IsExternal)
External tracks map by add order
DefaultAudioStreamIndex and DefaultSubtitleStreamIndex set the initial tracks
Rust tests cover an item with one external subtitle and embedded tracks

tasks.title: Stable DeviceId, server logout, and failed stop reports
acceptance: DeviceId is derived from a persisted install id, server id, and user id
Logout calls POST /Sessions/Logout
Stopped reports after errors send Failed: true

tasks.title: Upgrade the SDK and replace obsolete paths
acceptance: @jellyfin/sdk is 1.0.x
/Users/{userId}/Items is replaced with /Items
Invalid fields values are removed

tasks.title: Dogfood the codec matrix on NVIDIA and AMD
acceptance: Every sample plays to first frame and EOF on the RTX 4070 Ti with hwdec-current recorded
Every sample plays on the Radeon 610M with VA-API hwdec-current recorded
Tripwire passes on both servers
Results are recorded in docs/validation.md evidence
Hankflix titles of each codec play on both GPUs

tasks.title: First dogfood play on Hankflix
acceptance: Fluster signs in to the LAN server from FLUSTER_DOGFOOD_SERVER
A movie and an episode play to first frame with hardware decoding
Resume position appears in the Jellyfin web UI
The server dashboard shows Direct Play and no active transcodes

phases.name: Structure by domain
phases.goal: Core code matches DOMAINS.md and new UI has a home in src/features/; proof-of-concept UI is frozen, not refactored.
exit: Boundary lint passes with no exceptions

tasks.title: Create the composition root and feature skeleton
acceptance: src/app/compose.ts is the only place that constructs the gateway and player engines
src/app/App.tsx routes between src/features/ views and the proof-of-concept screens
src/features/ has empty sign-in, home, browse, detail, and player folders with an index view each
The proof-of-concept flow and existing e2e journeys still pass

tasks.title: Separate catalog types from playback types
acceptance: LibraryItem and catalog types live in src/domain/catalog.ts
src/domain/playback.ts holds only negotiation and engine types

tasks.title: Extract source acceptance and DeviceProfile modules
acceptance: Source acceptance and the profile live in their own adapter modules with their own tests

tasks.title: Split mpv.rs into player modules and commands.rs
acceptance: Track mapping, diagnostics, and the controller live in separate files under src-tauri/src/player/
Command handlers live in commands.rs
No file exceeds about 400 lines
Behavior and tests are unchanged
tasks.verify: cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml

tasks.title: Extract the playstate reporter from the coordinator
acceptance: Reporting lives in its own module
Order, bounded drain, and failure-as-warning tests pass unchanged

phases.name: Daily driver (M1)
phases.goal: The developer watches everything on this computer with Fluster instead of the Jellyfin web UI.
exit: Every flow has a Playwright journey

tasks.title: Decide persistent sign-in storage
acceptance: A decision record covers opt-in keyring storage
docs/security.md reflects the decision

tasks.title: Store credentials in the OS keyring
acceptance: Rust owns a credential vault backed by Secret Service on Linux
Opt-in stay-signed-in restores the session after restart via GET /Users/Me
A 401 returns to sign-in and clears the stored credential
The token never enters WebView storage
tasks.verify: pnpm check && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml vault

tasks.title: Discover servers on the LAN
acceptance: UDP 7359 discovery lists servers by name and id
Choosing one probes /System/Info/Public
Hankflix is discovered on the LAN

acceptance: Segments load only when HasSegments is true

tasks.title: Keyboard navigation, media keys, and MPRIS

phases.name: Dogfood week
phases.goal: Use Fluster as the only Jellyfin client on this computer for seven days.
exit: No fallback to the web UI was needed
Every issue found is a task or fixed

tasks.title: Keep a dogfood log for seven days
acceptance: docs/dogfood/YYYY-MM-DD.md records each session, what was watched, and every problem
Hankflix shows no transcode or remux jobs for the week

tasks.title: Triage dogfood findings into tasks
acceptance: Every problem in the log is fixed or added to this file as a task
